name: IOIPG Malaysia Real Estate Investment Trust
overview: IOIPG Malaysia Real Estate Investment Trust 于2026年进行首次公开募股，发售最多22亿个单位，包括零售发售7.156亿个单位及机构发售最多14.844亿个单位。此次IPO涉及向IOI Properties Group Berhad股东、合格董事、员工及业务伙伴进行限制性发售，以及向马来西亚公众公开发售。
overview_en: IOIPG Malaysia Real Estate Investment Trust conducted an initial public offering in 2026, offering up to 2.2 billion units, comprising a retail offering of 715.6 million units and an institutional offering of up to 1.484 billion units. The IPO involved restricted offerings to entitled shareholders of IOI Properties Group Berhad, eligible directors, employees and business associates, as well as a public offering to the Malaysian public.
